description: Explicitly selected named recipes; source preparation facts reviewed and rewritten. No creator or country inferred.

items.instructions: Shake everything vigorously with ice. Double-strain into a cold coupe and add a celery stick.

snapshot.name: The Celery Sour
ingredients: 1.50 fl oz Hendrick's Gin
0.67 fl oz Freshly squeezed lemon juice
0.33 fl oz Fresh pressed pineapple juice
0.33 fl oz Giffard Sugar Cane Syrup (Sirop Sucre de Canne)
0.08 fl oz Fee Brother's Celery Bitters
0.50 fl oz Fee Brothers Fee Foam Egg White Alternative

items.garnish: Half a cherry tomato and a small basil sprig
items.instructions: Crush the tomato and basil in a shaker. Add the liquids and ice, then shake thoroughly. Double-strain into a cold coupe; garnish the rim with half a cherry tomato and a small basil sprig.

snapshot.name: Tomato Blossom Daiquiri
ingredients: 1.00 fresh Cherry tomato (chopped)
4.00 fresh Basil leaves
1.67 fl oz Planteray 3 Stars White Rum
0.83 fl oz Freshly squeezed lemon juice
0.83 fl oz St-Germain Elderflower Liqueur
0.17 fl oz Giffard Sugar Cane Syrup (Sirop Sucre de Canne)

items.instructions: Shake the whiskey, Drambuie, both bitters and lemon juice with ice. Strain over fresh ice in a Collins glass, then add the ginger ale.

snapshot.name: Dublin Rusty Mule
ingredients: 2.00 fl oz Jameson Irish Whiskey
1.00 fl oz Drambuie Liqueur
2.00 dash Angostura Orange Bitters
4.00 dash Angostura Aromatic Bitters
0.25 fl oz Freshly squeezed lemon juice
2.50 fl oz Ginger ale

items.garnish: Pink grapefruit wedge and scorched rosemary sprig
items.instructions: Combine the sloe gin, sherry and Suze over ice in an old-fashioned glass. Stir to mix and chill. Finish with pink grapefruit and a scorched rosemary sprig.

snapshot.name: Sloe Burn Sipper
ingredients: 1.33 fl oz Hayman's Sloe Gin
1.00 fl oz Valdespino Inocente Fino Sherry
0.67 fl oz Suze Aperitif

items.instructions: Shake the gin, cherry liqueur and orange juice with ice. Strain over fresh ice in a Collins glass. Add ginger beer to fill and garnish with an orange slice.

snapshot.name: Cherry Gin Buck
ingredients: 2.00 fl oz Beefeater London Dry Gin
0.75 fl oz Heering Cherry Liqueur
1.50 fl oz Freshly squeezed orange juice
Top up with Three Cents Ginger Beer

items.instructions: Combine the rum, lime juice, cane syrup and ginger beer over ice in a Collins glass. Stir gently and finish with a wedge of lime.

snapshot.name: Spiced Rum Cooler
ingredients: 2.00 fl oz Don Q Oak Barrel Spiced Rum
0.50 fl oz Freshly squeezed lime juice
0.50 fl oz Giffard Sugar Cane Syrup (Sirop Sucre de Canne)
2.50 fl oz Three Cents Ginger Beer

items.instructions: Combine the gin, Kina and Suze over ice in an old-fashioned glass. Stir to mix and chill, then add a twist of orange zest.

snapshot.name: Gilded Bitter
ingredients: 1.00 fl oz Beefeater London Dry Gin
2.00 fl oz Tempus Fugit Kina L'Aero d'Or
0.50 fl oz Suze Aperitif

items.instructions: Shake the vodka, Grand Marnier, lemon juice and cane syrup with ice. Strain into a cold flute. Add ginger ale, stir gently and finish with a cape gooseberry.

snapshot.name: Golden Fizz Royale
ingredients: 1.00 fl oz Ketel One Vodka
1.00 fl oz Grand Marnier
0.50 fl oz Freshly squeezed lemon juice
0.25 fl oz Giffard Sugar Cane Syrup (Sirop Sucre de Canne)
1.50 fl oz Ginger ale
